label: Generic knowledge work
description: Domain-neutral fallback used when no profession-specific profile applies.
extractionGuidance:
Record a judgment when the reasoning behind it may matter again later: an option chosen over a named alternative, something explicitly rejected, a constraint accepted, a scope boundary drawn, or work deliberately postponed.

Do not record routine execution, wording preferences, or suggestions nobody acted on.
distillationGuidance: Look for judgments that recur across unrelated situations. State the pattern in the user's own terms, without borrowing vocabulary from any particular profession.
